summary: Genmab A/S filed a Form 6-K furnishing an English translation of its Articles of Association, effective September 8, 2026, signed by CFO Anthony Pagano. The document restates share capital of DKK 62,405,855 in DKK 1 shares, board authorizations to increase capital by up to nominally DKK 6,600,000 with and without pre-emption rights through March 12, 2029, and employee warrant programs. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation is disclosed; incorporated by reference into existing Form S-8 registration statements. No deal terms and no risk-arb angle apply.
